hero.title: A family tradition *of caring for families*
hero.lede: Dr. Stephen Baker carries on the family dentistry his father, Dr. Fred Baker, began in his hometown of Aiken: checkups and cleanings, repairs and crowns, and cosmetic dentistry for every age.

items.title: Cleanings
items.text: Routine cleanings that help prevent gum disease, decay and tooth loss.

items.title: Exams & screenings
items.text: Checks for oral cancer, tooth decay and gum disease, so problems are caught early.

items.title: Restorative dentistry
items.text: Repairs for chipped or broken teeth, and crowns.

items.title: Cosmetic dentistry
items.text: Whitening, bonding and veneers for a smile you’ll want to show off.

items.title: Braces
items.text: Straighter teeth for children and adults.

items.title: Advanced care
items.text: Root canals and oral surgery, made as comfortable as we can.

sections.title: Two generations *of Dr. Baker*
body: Dr. Fred L. Baker graduated from the Medical University of South Carolina in 1972, in only the second class since the school was formed, after earning a pharmacy degree at the University of South Carolina. He began practicing in his hometown of Aiken and dedicated more than 30 years to family dentistry. Retired now, he still helps out, and the paintings in the office are his, from art classes at USC Aiken.

His son, Dr. Stephen J. Baker, grew up in Aiken surrounded by dentistry. He graduated from The Citadel and then from MUSC’s dental school in 2003. He and his wife Dana have three boys, and he enjoys hunting, fishing, tennis and coaching his children’s teams.

Being a retired dentist, I was especially concerned about quality dental care. I have been a patient for 15 years and I am very pleased with the treatment I have received. Baker Family Dentistry is truly a family.
